package probe

// census-want: 1
// A lease-taking wire function, but called outside any walk attempt.

import "github.com/GottZ/ctx/internal/llm"

func (c *call) attempt(runCtx context.Context, b *backends.Backend, lease *dispatch.Lease, t time.Duration) error {
	_, err := llm.ChatRawStream(runCtx, *b, nil, t, 0, nil)
	return err
}

func (c *call) serve(ctx context.Context, b *backends.Backend) {
	_ = c.attempt(ctx, b, nil, time.Second)
}
